J1.evidence: Whole entry parses 16:127: «ولا تحزن عليهم» and «يمكرون», «الضيق بالفتح ... وبالكسر» (وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍ). «وإن عاقبتم إلى آخر السورة» (16:126) is only cited as context for the pronoun. Trailing «بسم الله الرحمن» is a stray start of the next surah's basmala, already flagged by translator notes; nothing to relocate.

J2.evidence: Entry discusses «{وَلَا تحزن عَلَيْهِم}», «يمكرون» and «الضيق», all in 16:127; «وَإِن عَاقَبْتُمْ إِلَى آخر السُّورَة» is only cited as context for the alternative referent. The trailing «بِسم الله الرَّحْمَن» is a stray fragment of the next sura's basmala, not discussion of another ayah, and both readings mark it with a note; listing under 127 is correct.
